Objective: Validate that a user can authenticate to the RMD application via the Keycloak sign-in page.
Preconditions: Application and Keycloak realm 'prospero' are reachable; valid user credentials (admin/admin) exist.
Steps: 1) Open the Keycloak OpenID Connect authorization URL for the RMD application; 2) Enter 'admin' in the Username or email field; 3) Enter 'admin' in the Password field; 4) Click Sign In.
ExpectedResult: User is authenticated and redirected to the RMD application landing page without any login or server error.

Objective: Validate end-to-end creation of a new client including beneficial owner, address and related role.
Preconditions: User is active with valid credentials; reference data (account type 'Single Accounts', role 'Beneficiary', related party 'MICHAEL STARK') is available.
Steps: 1) Login with valid credentials (admin/admin); 2) Open the 'New Client' screen; 3) Enter the client name 'test paw port'; 4) Select account type 'Single Accounts'; 5) Add a beneficial owner with First Name 'paw' and Last Name 'port'; 6) Add an address with value 'everywhere'; 7) Add a related role: select role 'Beneficiary' and related party 'MICHAEL STARK'; 8) Click 'Save Modifications'.
ExpectedResult: New client is created and saved successfully with the beneficial owner, address and related role persisted, and a success confirmation is shown with no UI or server error.

Summary: RMD - Trade Order Capture create - Manual
Objective: Validate capturing and submitting a trade order, including the optional order validation dialog.
Preconditions: User is active with valid credentials; at least one portfolio and one security are available for selection.
Steps: 1) Login with valid credentials (admin/admin); 2) Open the 'Trade Order Capture' screen; 3) Open the portfolio selector and select the first portfolio, then click Apply; 4) Open the security selector and select a security, then click Apply; 5) Enter quantity '200'; 6) Click 'Submit Order'; 7) If the 'Validate this order' dialog appears, enter a comment 'test' and click 'Send Order'; otherwise confirm the 'Edit Order' button is visible.
ExpectedResult: Trade order is submitted successfully; if validation is required the order is sent after entering the comment, otherwise the captured order is shown with the Edit Order action available, and no UI or server error appears.

Objective: Validate that the Trade Order Blotter opens and supports filtering by access level and group.
Preconditions: User is active with valid credentials; Trade Order Blotter data exists; filter values 'Full access' and 'Portfolio Managers' are available.
Steps: 1) Login with valid credentials (admin/admin); 2) Click the 'Trade Order Blotter' navigation link; 3) Open the access-level filter dropdown and select 'Full access'; 4) Open the group filter dropdown and select 'Portfolio Managers'; 5) Review the filtered blotter results.
ExpectedResult: Trade Order Blotter loads successfully, filters apply correctly, and the matching trade orders are listed with no UI or server error.
